capabilities: draw mind maps from outline-flow code blocks or a note's headings and lists
edit charts on the chart with keyboard commands and write changes back to the note
switch between four layouts and 17 themes
drag nodes with snapping and save positions per note
export all charts in a note as one self-contained HTML file
disambiguation: Not an outline-navigation tool; it turns outlines into editable mind-map and flowchart diagrams.
extras: Licensed GPL-3.0. Works offline; node positions are stored as JSON files in a configurable vault folder. Interface is English or Chinese depending on Obsidian's language setting.
intentEvidence: The syntax is compatible with Flowchart Fun and adds loops, summary braces and notes under nodes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see an outline as a diagram or edit a note's structure by manipulating nodes on a chart.

relations.evidence: The syntax is compatible with Flowchart Fun and adds loops, summary braces and notes

summary: Mind-map and flowchart renderer that draws charts from indented outlines or note headings, with on-chart keyboard editing and HTML export.
